label: Administrative
description: Interview date, survey, region, department, village and GPS. Village and department spellings corrected in the do-file, then OCHA codes attached.

label: Assistance
description: The 20 WFP intervention variables, last assistance date and cash amount.

label: Food consumption (FCS)
description: Days eaten per food group over 7 days and food sources. The FCS and its 21/35 and 28/42 groups are recomputed after the merge.

label: Household
description: Head of household (sex, age, education, activity, marital status), income source and household composition.

label: Livelihood coping (LCS)
description: 10 livelihood coping strategies recoded to one scale. The maximum coping category is computed after the merge.

label: Reduced coping (rCSI)
description: 5 consumption coping strategies. The rCSI is recomputed after the merge.

label: Resilience (SERS / RCS)
description: 10 self-evaluated resilience statements. The Resilience Capacity Score and its 33/66 groups are computed after the merge.

label: Asset benefit (ABI)
description: Asset benefit questions and the ABI score (0 to 7), for rounds after the baseline.

label: Dietary diversity (HDDS)
description: 12 food groups eaten in the last 24 hours, from PDM 2022. Built directly from the raw HDDS columns, outside the harmonisation workbook.

label: Shocks
description: 17 shocks over 12 months and 5 years (2021 annual to 2023 annual), and the main shock of the last 6 months (from 2022 PDM). Added by do-file 16.

label: Assets and livestock
description: 18 durable goods (2018 to 2021 PDM), livestock counts and tropical livestock units (8 rounds). Added by do-file 16.

label: Livelihoods
description: Number of income sources, up to three sources on one 15-source list, and the household's main activity. Added by do-file 16.

label: Agriculture
description: Farming, areas cultivated and owned, land tenure, months covered by own production and stocks. Added by do-file 16.

label: Expenditure
description: The analysts' monthly food and non-food totals, with the total and food share recomputed the same way in every round (2021 annual onwards). Added by do-file 17.

label: Disability
description: Washington Group questions on six domains for any household member (2021 annual onwards). Added by do-file 17.

label: Education
description: Children at primary school and school canteens (2019 to 2021 PDM); girls at school, programme support and intentions to complete school (2021 annual onwards). Added by do-file 17.

label: Migration
description: Members who migrated for work, how many, why, where to, for how long, and the trend (2021 annual onwards). Added by do-file 17.

label: Protection and accountability
description: Safety, access and problems linked to the assistance, travel and waiting times, complaints, knowledge of the programme, and who decides on resources and assistance (2019 to 2021 PDM, and from 2022 PDM). Added by do-file 18.

label: Debt
description: Debt contracted, its source, repayment and use for food (2018, 2022 annual and 2023), current debts and their reasons (2021 annual onwards). Added by do-file 18.

label: Social cohesion
description: Relations with transhumant herders, farmers, displaced people and hosts, whether assets reduced tensions, and whom the household could help (2021 annual, 2022 annual, 2023). Added by do-file 19.

label: Climate adaptation
description: Knowledge and use of four adaptation techniques, training, food processing and seven good practices (2021 annual, 2022 annual, 2023). Added by do-file 19.

label: Shock impact and recovery
description: For each of the 17 shocks, the impact on food consumption and income, and the ability to meet food needs now and in a year compared with before (2021 annual, 2022 annual, 2023). Added by do-file 20.

label: Programme effects
description: Areas the household says the activities changed (income, food, coping, shocks, diet, childcare, schooling, assets) and in which direction (2022 PDM onwards). Added by do-file 20.

label: Markets
description: Difficulties reaching markets and their causes, distance, days per week at the market, and produce sold (2022 PDM onwards). Added by do-file 20.

label: More accountability questions
description: Assistance received, satisfaction, information, respect, dignified sites, who decides on the assistance, ration duration, voice and safety of travel (2021 annual or 2022 onwards). Added by do-file 20.

label: Additions to earlier modules
description: Food shortage and malnourished child (2018 to 2021 PDM), disabled member, earlier income activity, migration trend reasons, savings groups, past girls' support. Added by do-file 20.
